mainText: Faisal Islam: How high will interest rates go?. The BBC's economics editor views one more interest rate as likely, but thinks that will be all. Channel 4 has apologised and said the show's budget would be reinvested  in "distinctive new programming". Could this be the last Bonfire Night for noisy fireworks at home?.
